bookkeeping.title: Bookkeeping & Accounting
bookkeeping.heroTitle: Bookkeeping and accounting in Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina
bookkeeping.shortDescription: Complete bookkeeping, accounting records, payroll calculations, VAT records, and year-end reports for sole traders and companies.
bookkeeping.heroDescription: Bookkeeping services for limited liability companies (d.o.o.), sole traders and associations in Sarajevo and Ilidža: posting invoices and expenses, payroll and contribution calculations, VAT and the annual year-end accounts – accurate and ahead of deadlines.
bookkeeping.overview: We organize the full bookkeeping cycle: document intake, invoice and expense posting, payroll and contribution calculations, VAT records, statutory filings, and annual closing. The goal is simple: clean records, clear responsibilities, and no last-minute surprises.
bookkeeping.localContextTitle: Bookkeeping for companies and sole traders in Sarajevo and Ilidža
bookkeeping.localContext: Start HN is an accounting agency based at Ibrahima Ljubovića 47, 71210 Ilidža, working with companies, sole traders and associations from Ilidža, Sarajevo and Sarajevo Canton. We keep business books in line with the regulations of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina (FBiH): posting incoming and outgoing invoices and expenses, payroll and contribution calculations, VAT records and returns, and the annual year-end accounts. You can deliver documents in person, by email or digitally. We work primarily in Pantheon, and we can also work in the system your company already uses.
bestFor: Small and medium companies that need regular accounting support
Sole traders (obrt) and freelancers who want tidy statutory records
Teams switching from another accountant
Owners who want clear monthly numbers, not only annual filings

details.title: Bookkeeping setup and handover
details.description: We review your registration, existing records, opening balances, payroll data, and reporting calendar so the service starts from a clean baseline.

details.title: Monthly accounting operations
details.description: We handle invoices, expenses, bank transactions, payroll, contributions, VAT records and recurring statutory obligations in a predictable monthly rhythm.

details.title: Annual statements and closing
details.description: We prepare year-end calculations, financial statements, tax declarations, and closing documentation so the business remains compliant and audit-ready.

process.title: Collect
process.description: You send documents digitally or physically according to the agreed workflow.

process.title: Process
process.description: We post transactions, calculate obligations, and check records before deadlines.

process.title: Report
process.description: You receive clear summaries and next actions, with questions resolved before they become risks.

bookkeeping.interiorAlt: Accountant at a computer with a checklist of completed monthly tasks: VAT return, payroll and bookkeeping entries

cta.title: Ready to organize your books?
cta.description: We will review your current records and define a monthly accounting workflow that fits how your business actually operates.

items.question: How much does bookkeeping cost for a sole trader or an LLC?
items.answer: For newly founded sole traders (obrt), prices start from 150 KM (about €77) per month, and for newly founded limited liability companies (d.o.o.) from 300 KM (about €153) per month. The final price depends on the size of the business, the volume of documents, the number of employees and the complexity of operations, with no hidden costs.

items.question: How do we send you our documents?
items.answer: In person at our office in Ilidža, by email or digitally – whichever workflow we agree on at the start. We then post the transactions and check the records before the deadlines.

items.question: Can we switch to you from another accountant?
items.answer: Yes. We review your registration, existing records, opening balances, payroll data and reporting calendar, agree on the handover of documents and have you fully set up within a few days. For companies and sole traders switching agencies, we set the price after a short review of the business.

items.question: Which accounting software do you use?
items.answer: We work primarily in Pantheon, and we also have experience with e-line, Microsoft Dynamics NAV and InfoSoft. If your company already uses a program and has an active contract with its provider, we can work in your system.

items.question: Is there a long-term commitment?
items.answer: No. There is no long-term lock-in – we work to earn your trust every month.

pricing.title: How much bookkeeping costs
pricing.intro: The price depends on the size and complexity of your business, with no hidden costs. Starting prices for newly founded businesses:
pricing.note: For existing companies and sole traders switching from another accounting agency, we set the price individually after a short review of the business and its needs.

payroll.title: Payroll and contributions
payroll.body: For businesses with employees, we calculate salaries and the related contributions and prepare the statutory returns as part of monthly bookkeeping, ahead of the deadlines. When we take over your books, we review your payroll data so the calculations are accurate from the first month. The number of employees is one of the factors that affect the price.

taxConsulting.title: Tax Consulting
taxConsulting.heroTitle: Tax consulting and VAT services in Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina
taxConsulting.shortDescription: Tax monitoring, planning, filing support, deadline tracking, and practical guidance for individuals and companies.
taxConsulting.heroDescription: Tax obligations change quickly and mistakes are expensive. We help you understand what applies, what is due, and how to plan within the rules.
taxConsulting.overviewTitle: Tax advice before there is a problem
taxConsulting.overview: Our tax support connects compliance and planning: we monitor deadlines, review obligations, explain regulatory changes, prepare filings, and advise on decisions before they create avoidable cost or risk.
taxConsulting.localContextTitle: Tax obligations for companies and sole traders in the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina
taxConsulting.localContext: Companies and sole traders based in Sarajevo and elsewhere in the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina (FBiH) have tax obligations under the regulations of Bosnia and Herzegovina (BiH) and of the FBiH. From our office in Ilidža we prepare and file VAT returns, corporate and personal income tax returns and other statutory returns, follow regulatory changes and let you know in good time when a change affects your business. Tax advice works best when it is linked to accurate bookkeeping, because returns are then based on reliable records.
bestFor: Companies that need regular tax monitoring
Owners making investment, hiring, or pricing decisions
Individuals and entrepreneurs with reporting obligations
Businesses that want to reduce penalties and late corrections

details.title: Obligation review
details.description: We review active registrations, previous filings, payroll and VAT exposure, and upcoming deadlines.

details.title: Compliance and filing support
details.description: We prepare and review tax submissions, monitor deadlines, and help correct issues before they become penalties.

details.title: Planning and decision support
details.description: We explain tax effects of business decisions, deductions, entity changes, hiring, payments, and other recurring financial questions.

process.title: Assess
process.description: We map your current tax position and identify open obligations or risk areas.

process.title: Plan
process.description: We define deadlines, responsibilities, and legal planning opportunities.

process.title: Maintain
process.description: We keep filings and advice aligned with your business activity and regulatory updates.

taxConsulting.interiorAlt: Tax adviser walking a client through an overview of tax obligations on a screen

cta.title: Need clarity on tax obligations?
cta.description: Send us your current situation and we will help you understand what is due, what can be improved, and what should happen next.

items.question: Which tax returns do you prepare?
items.answer: We prepare and file VAT returns, corporate income tax and personal income tax returns, and other statutory returns under BiH and FBiH regulations.

items.question: How will we hear about changes in tax rules?
items.answer: From us. We track regulatory changes and let you know as soon as a change affects your business, so you are never caught off guard.

items.question: Do you advise individuals as well?
items.answer: Yes. We provide tax advice to companies, sole traders and individuals who have to file tax returns.

items.question: Why is tax advice linked to bookkeeping?
items.answer: Because tax returns are based on your records. When the books are accurate and up to date, the returns are accurate too, and our advice is based on real numbers.

items.question: What if an earlier return contains a mistake?
items.answer: We review earlier returns and help correct any errors before they turn into penalties or late corrections.

virtualCfo.title: Virtual CFO
virtualCfo.heroTitle: Virtual CFO services for SMEs in Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina
virtualCfo.shortDescription: Senior financial insight without a full-time finance director: cash flow, budgeting, KPIs, and decision support.
virtualCfo.heroDescription: A Virtual CFO gives owners and management a clearer view of financial health, cash flow, profitability, and strategic choices.
virtualCfo.overviewTitle: Financial leadership on a flexible basis
virtualCfo.overview: We translate accounting data into practical management insight: budgets, forecasts, cash-flow planning, profitability analysis, and financial indicators that show where the company is strong and where attention is needed.
virtualCfo.localContextTitle: Financial leadership without a full-time finance director
virtualCfo.localContext: Many small and medium-sized businesses in Sarajevo and Sarajevo Canton do not need a full-time finance director, but they do need reliable numbers for their decisions. As a virtual CFO, Start HN prepares cash-flow forecasts, plans budgets, carries out financial analysis and prepares reports for management, and we attend meetings when needed. When we also keep your books, the analysis is based on up-to-date figures from your business records. The service is particularly useful for owners preparing financing or investment decisions.
bestFor: Growing companies that need more than bookkeeping
Owners preparing for financing or investment decisions
Teams without an internal finance director
Managers who want monthly numbers turned into action

details.title: Financial health review
details.description: We analyze profitability, liquidity, cost structure, receivables, payables, and key risks in the current financial picture.

details.title: Planning and forecasting
details.description: We prepare budgets, cash-flow forecasts, scenario views, and assumptions that make management decisions easier to evaluate.

details.title: Management reporting
details.description: We define KPIs and reporting formats that connect financial data with decisions about growth, costs, pricing, and operations.

virtualCfo.processTitle: How the virtual CFO service works

process.title: Diagnose
process.description: We review existing reports and identify the financial questions management needs answered.

process.title: Model
process.description: We build practical budgets, forecasts, and scenario views based on real operating assumptions.

process.title: Advise
process.description: We meet regularly to explain results, risks, and recommended next steps.

virtualCfo.interiorAlt: Printed cash-flow forecast with a chart and a table on a desk

cta.title: Need CFO-level clarity?
cta.description: We can turn your accounting data into a management view that supports growth, financing, and better decisions.

items.question: What does the virtual CFO service include?
items.answer: Cash-flow forecasts, budget planning, financial analysis, management reports and strategic advice, with attendance at meetings when needed.

items.question: Who is a virtual CFO for?
items.answer: Growing companies that need financial leadership but are not yet ready for a full-time finance director, and owners preparing financing or investment decisions.

items.question: What does working together look like?
items.answer: We start by reviewing your existing reports and defining the questions management needs answered. We then build budgets, forecasts and scenarios based on realistic assumptions, and regularly explain results, risks and next steps.

items.question: Why does it help if you also keep our books?
items.answer: Because the analysis is then based on up-to-date figures from your own accounting records, which makes forecasts and reports more reliable.

businessConsulting.title: Business Consulting
businessConsulting.heroTitle: Business consulting for companies and sole traders in Bosnia and Herzegovina
businessConsulting.shortDescription: Practical business advice for structure, growth, internal processes, costs, pricing, and operational decisions.
businessConsulting.heroDescription: Good accounting shows what happened. Good consulting helps you decide what should happen next.
businessConsulting.overview: We support owners and managers with financial and operational decisions: business setup, process improvement, cost control, pricing, cash discipline, internal documentation, and growth planning.
businessConsulting.localContextTitle: Business consulting for entrepreneurs in Sarajevo
businessConsulting.localContext: We help entrepreneurs, sole traders and companies from Sarajevo and Ilidža make business decisions based on the numbers in their own books. We advise on business organisation and document flow, cost control, pricing, collecting receivables and growth planning. Startups and new businesses get our support from their first day of operations, and our guide to starting a business in Bosnia and Herzegovina (BiH) explains how to choose between a sole trader (obrt) and a limited liability company (d.o.o.). Our advice is connected to bookkeeping and tax, so it also takes your legal obligations in the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina (FBiH) into account.
bestFor: New businesses setting up financial processes
Companies improving internal controls and document flow
Owners evaluating costs, pricing, or expansion
Teams that want advice connected to accounting reality

details.title: Business setup and organization
details.description: We help define document flows, reporting responsibilities, accounting routines, and practical controls for daily operations.

details.title: Financial decision support
details.description: We review costs, margins, pricing, cash needs, and planned investments so decisions are based on measurable impact.

details.title: Process improvement
details.description: We identify where paperwork, approvals, reporting, or cash collection can be simplified and made more reliable.

process.title: Map
process.description: We map the current process, documents, and financial questions.

process.title: Prioritize

process.title: Implement
process.description: We define practical steps, responsibilities, and follow-up reporting.

businessConsulting.interiorAlt: Business consultant reviewing charts and notes with a client at a desk

cta.title: Need a practical business review?
cta.description: We will look at your numbers and operating flow, then recommend the changes most likely to improve control and profitability.

items.question: What can business consulting help us with?
items.answer: Organising your business and document flow, cost control, pricing, collecting receivables and growth planning – all based on the numbers in your own books.

items.question: Do you work with new businesses and startups?
items.answer: Yes. We support startups and new businesses from their first day of operations, and our guide to starting a business in Bosnia and Herzegovina explains how to choose between a sole trader (obrt) and an LLC (d.o.o.).

items.question: How does the consulting process work?
items.answer: We first map your current processes, documents and financial questions. We then pick the changes that bring the most value and define practical steps, responsibilities and follow-up.

items.question: Do your recommendations take legal obligations into account?
items.answer: Yes. Our consulting is connected to bookkeeping and tax, so our recommendations also reflect your legal obligations in the FBiH.

financialReporting.title: Financial Reporting
financialReporting.heroTitle: Financial reporting and year-end accounts in Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina
financialReporting.shortDescription: Clear statutory and management reporting that helps you understand performance, obligations, and financial trends.
financialReporting.heroDescription: Reports should not be confusing files that only satisfy a deadline. They should explain what is happening in the business.
financialReporting.overviewTitle: Reports that management can actually use
financialReporting.overview: We prepare statutory reports, management summaries, financial statements, and analysis formats that make revenue, cost, profit, liquidity, and obligations easier to understand.
financialReporting.localContextTitle: Year-end accounts and reporting for companies in the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina
financialReporting.localContext: Companies in the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina (FBiH) are required by law to prepare annual financial statements, and owners and management also need clear management reports during the year. For clients from Sarajevo, Ilidža and Sarajevo Canton we prepare the annual year-end accounts and statutory financial statements, monthly or quarterly management summaries, and report packages for banks and partners. Reports are based on well-kept accounting records, and we explain results, obligations and trends in plain language.
bestFor: Companies that need clearer monthly reporting
Managers preparing bank, partner, or investor documentation
Owners who want to track profit and cash consistently
Businesses that need statutory and management views aligned

details.title: Statutory financial reporting

details.title: Management reporting
details.description: We create concise monthly or quarterly summaries that explain performance, obligations, margins, and trends.

details.title: Financial analysis
details.description: We interpret the numbers with ratios, comparisons, and commentary that support decisions rather than only recordkeeping.

process.title: Structure
process.description: We define what the report should answer and who will use it.

process.title: Prepare

process.title: Explain

financialReporting.interiorAlt: Two professionals reviewing printed financial reports with charts

cta.title: Want reports that are easier to use?
cta.description: We can turn your accounting data into a clear reporting format for management, partners, banks, or internal planning.

items.question: Which reports do you prepare?
items.answer: Annual year-end accounts and statutory financial statements, monthly or quarterly management summaries, and report packages for banks and partners.

items.question: Does a company have to prepare annual financial statements?
items.answer: Yes. Companies in the FBiH are required by law to prepare annual financial statements, and we prepare them from well-kept accounting records.

items.question: Can you prepare reports for a bank or business partners?
items.answer: Yes. We prepare report packages for banks, partners and investors, based on clean accounting records and supporting documents.

items.question: Will you explain the numbers to us?
items.answer: Yes. We explain results, obligations and trends in plain language, using ratios, comparisons and commentary that support decisions.

education.title: Education & Courses
education.heroTitle: Accounting and tax training in Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina
education.shortDescription: Accounting, tax, and finance workshops that help owners and teams understand obligations and make better decisions.
education.heroDescription: Better financial literacy reduces mistakes, improves internal communication, and helps teams work with accountants more effectively.
education.overviewTitle: Knowledge that makes daily work easier
education.overview: We organize practical education for owners, managers, and administrative teams: accounting basics, document preparation, tax deadlines, payroll basics, reporting interpretation, and better cooperation with accounting teams.
education.localContext: For companies and sole traders from Sarajevo and Ilidža that handle part of their administration or bookkeeping in-house, we provide individual professional support and practical training. This can include organising internal documentation, training staff to use accounting software, the basics of accounting processes, and helping management read financial statements. Sole traders who keep their own books can get individual consultations on their legal obligations and records in the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina (FBiH). We tailor the content to how your team actually works, using examples from everyday practice.
bestFor: Owners who want to understand their obligations
Administrative staff handling documents and invoices
Teams preparing for new reporting processes
Managers who want to read financial reports with confidence

items.question: Who is the training for?
items.answer: Owners, managers and administrative staff of companies and sole traders, especially those who handle part of their administration or bookkeeping in-house.

items.question: Which topics do you cover?
items.answer: Accounting basics, document preparation, tax deadlines, payroll basics, working in accounting software and reading financial statements.

items.question: Do you offer one-to-one consultations for sole traders?
items.answer: Yes. Sole traders who keep their own books can get individual consultations and practical explanations of their legal obligations and records.

items.question: Can the training be tailored to our team?
items.answer: Yes. We tailor the content to how your team actually works, with examples from everyday practice, and leave the team with checklists and routines to apply.
